newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - GILTS TO FACE STERN RESISTANCE AT 115-00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - GILTS TO FACE STERN RESISTANCE AT 115-00.

text.p: September gilt futures traded on LIFFE will attempt to reach the 115-00 resistance level on Thursday, the top of the current range, but will find the going tough, technical analysts said.
Congestion around there is backed up by a trendline drawn from the 116-02 contract highs on July 30 and 31, which comes in around 115-02/04.
"The bias is to the upside. If they can get through the resistance line, then they'll have a chance of getting to 116-02 in the next two weeks," said a technical analyst at a European bank in London.
September gilt futures were up 11/32 at 114-22 by 0725 GMT.
A trader at another European bank said the 114-00 to 115-00 range was holding sway at the moment, and gilts could lack the momentum to push outside it.
"Even when there are breakouts, then the market is not performing on the back of them," he said. "A lot of traders are getting whipped about."
The European analyst said however that the August 8 breakdown, to 113-28 would not undermine gilts.
"Last Friday's low indicated the selling climax," he said. "The trend is still up."
The trader said he would like to see a close well above 115-00, of at least 115-08/09 in order to confirm the upside.
Above the 115-00 level, the next resistance was the August 7 high at 115-19, analysts said.
On the downside, there was interim support at 114-12/13 from congestion, and a break below the range bottom at 114-00 would lead to the 113-28 low and then to congestion at 113-24.
At the short end, December short sterling futures were up two basis points at 92.64.
